verses.en: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 当犹大王约坦、亚哈斯、希西家在位的时候，摩利沙人弥迦得耶和华的默示，论撒马利亚和耶路撒冷。

words.g: Micah, the name of seven Israelites
the + a Morashtite or inhabitant of Moresheth-Gath
Jotham, the name of three Israelites
Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
and + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.zh: 万民哪，你们都要听！地和其上所有的，也都要侧耳而听！主耶和华从他的圣殿要见证你们的不是。

words.g: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken

verses.en: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
verses.zh: 看哪，耶和华出了他的居所，降临步行地的高处。

verses.en: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.zh: 众山在他以下必消化，诸谷必崩裂，如蜡化在火中，如水冲下山坡。

verses.en: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?
verses.zh: 这都因雅各的罪过，以色列家的罪恶。雅各的罪过在哪里呢？岂不是在撒马利亚吗？犹大的邱坛在哪里呢？岂不是在耶路撒冷吗？

words.g: and + in + an offence , and its penalty
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.
verses.zh: 所以我必使撒马利亚变为田野的乱堆，又作为种葡萄之处；也必将她的石头倒在谷中，露出根基来。

words.g: to + something planted, i.e. the place

verses.en: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”
verses.zh: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎；她所得的财物必被火烧；所有的偶像我必毁灭；因为是从妓女雇价所聚来的，后必归为妓女的雇价。

verses.en: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.
verses.zh: 先知说：因此我必大声哀号，赤脚露体而行；又要呼号如野狗，哀鸣如鸵鸟。

words.g: to tear the hair and beat the breasts
and + nude, either partially or totally
like + a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal

verses.en: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 因为撒马利亚的伤痕无法医治，延及犹大和耶路撒冷我民的城门。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
verses.zh: 不要在迦特报告这事，总不要哭泣；我在伯・亚弗拉滚于灰尘之中。

words.g: in + Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine

verses.en: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
verses.zh: 沙斐的居民哪，你们要赤身蒙羞过去。撒南的居民不敢出来。伯・以薛人的哀哭使你们无处可站。

words.g: to tear the hair and beat the breasts

verses.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 玛律的居民心甚忧急，切望得好处，因为灾祸从耶和华那里临到耶路撒冷的城门。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
verses.zh: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快马套车；锡安民（原文是女子）的罪由你而起；以色列人的罪过在你那里显出。

words.g: to + a relay of animals on a post-route

verses.en: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
verses.zh: 犹大啊，你要将礼物送给摩利设・迦特。亚革悉的众族必用诡诈待以色列诸王。

words.g: Akzib, the name of two places in Palestine

verses.en: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
verses.zh: 玛利沙的居民哪，我必使那夺取你的来到你这里；以色列的尊贵人（原文是荣耀）必到亚杜兰。

words.g: Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine
weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
verses.zh: 犹大啊，要为你所喜爱的儿女剪除你的头发，使头光秃，要大大地光秃，如同秃鹰，因为他们都被掳去离开你。

verses.en: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.zh: 祸哉，那些在床上图谋罪孽、造作奸恶的！天一发亮，因手有能力就行出来了。

words.g: and + to do or make , especially to practise

verses.en: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.zh: 他们贪图田地就占据，贪图房屋便夺取；他们欺压人，霸占房屋和产业。

words.g: and + to press upon, i.e. oppress

verses.en: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
verses.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：我筹划灾祸降与这族；这祸在你们的颈项上不能解脱；你们也不能昂首而行，因为这时势是恶的。

words.g: the + a family, i.e. circle of relatives

verses.en: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
verses.zh: 到那日，必有人向你们提起悲惨的哀歌，讥刺说：我们全然败落了！耶和华将我们的分转归别人，何竟使这分离开我们？他将我们的田地分给悖逆的人。

words.g: a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature
to + apostate, i.e. heathenish or  heathen

verses.en: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.
verses.zh: 所以在耶和华的会中，你必没有人拈阄拉准绳。

words.g: a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”
verses.zh: 他们（或译：假先知）说：你们不可说预言；不可向这些人说预言，不住地羞辱我们。

verses.en: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
verses.zh: 雅各家啊，岂可说耶和华的心不忍耐吗（或译：心肠狭窄吗）？这些事是他所行的吗？我―耶和华的言语岂不是与行动正直的人有益吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
verses.zh: 然而，近来我的民兴起如仇敌，从那些安然经过不愿打仗之人身上剥去外衣。

verses.en: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.
verses.zh: 你们将我民中的妇人从安乐家中赶出，又将我的荣耀从她们的小孩子尽行夺去。

verses.en: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
verses.zh: 你们起来去吧！这不是你们安息之所；因为污秽使人（或译：地）毁灭，而且大大毁灭。

words.g: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense
to wind tightly , i.e. to bind
and + a rope , especially a measuring line
to press, i.e.  to be pungent or vehement

verses.en: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
verses.zh: 若有人心存虚假，用谎言说：我要向你们预言得清酒和浓酒。那人就必作这民的先知。

words.g: and + to + an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor

verses.en: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.
verses.zh: 雅各家啊，我必要聚集你们，必要招聚以色列剩下的人，安置在一处，如波斯拉的羊，又如草场上的羊群；因为人数众多就必大大喧哗。

words.g: to make an uproar, or agitate greatly

verses.en: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.
verses.zh: 开路的（或译：破城的）在他们前面上去；他们直闯过城门，从城门出去。他们的王在前面行；耶和华引导他们。

verses.en: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
verses.zh: 我说：雅各的首领，以色列家的官长啊，你们要听！你们不当知道公平吗？

words.g: and + a magistrate  or other leader

verses.en: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.zh: 你们恶善好恶，从人身上剥皮，从人骨头上剔肉，

words.g: and + flesh , as living or forfood + +them/their

verses.en: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
verses.zh: 吃我民的肉，剥他们的皮，打折他们的骨头，分成块子像要下锅，又像釜中的肉。

verses.en: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”
verses.zh: 到了遭灾的时候，这些人必哀求耶和华，他却不应允他们。那时他必照他们所行的恶事向他们掩面。

words.g: and + to hide , literally or figuratively

verses.en: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
verses.zh: 论到使我民走差路的先知―他们牙齿有所嚼的，他们就呼喊说：平安了！凡不供给他们吃的，他们就预备攻击他（预备攻击他：或译说必遭遇刀兵）―耶和华如此说：

words.g: the + a prophet or  inspired man
the + to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
the + to strike with a sting
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
verses.zh: 你们必遭遇黑夜，以致不见异象；又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。日头必向你们沉落，白昼变为黑暗。

words.g: from + a sight , i.e. a dream
from + to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll
the + a prophet or  inspired man
and + to be ashy, i.e. darkcolored

verses.en: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
verses.zh: 先见必抱愧，占卜的必蒙羞，都必捂着嘴唇，因为神不应允他们。

words.g: and + to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
the + to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll

verses.en: But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
verses.zh: 至于我，我藉耶和华的灵，满有力量、公平、才能，可以向雅各说明他的过犯，向以色列指出他的罪恶。

words.g: and + however or on the contrary

verses.en: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,
verses.zh: 雅各家的首领、以色列家的官长啊，当听我的话！你们厌恶公平，在一切事上屈枉正直；

words.g: and + a magistrate  or other leader

verses.en: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.zh: 以人血建立锡安，以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。

words.g: and + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”
verses.zh: 首领为贿赂行审判；祭司为雇价施训诲；先知为银钱行占卜。他们却倚赖耶和华，说：耶和华不是在我们中间吗？灾祸必不临到我们。

words.g: and + a prophet or  inspired man + +her/its
to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +us/our

verses.en: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.
verses.zh: 所以因你们的缘故，锡安必被耕种像一块田，耶路撒冷必变为乱堆；这殿的山必像丛林的高处。

words.g: and + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.
verses.zh: 末后的日子，耶和华殿的山必坚立，超乎诸山，高举过于万岭；万民都要流归这山。

words.g: in + the last or end, hence
and + to sparkle, i.e.  be cheerful

verses.en: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;
verses.zh: 必有许多国的民前往，说：来吧，我们登耶和华的山，奔雅各神的殿。主必将他的道教训我们；我们也要行他的路。因为训诲必出于锡安；耶和华的言语必出于耶路撒冷。

words.g: from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
from + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.
verses.zh: 他必在多国的民中施行审判，为远方强盛的国断定是非。他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。这国不举刀攻击那国；他们也不再学习战事。

words.g: and + to bruise or violently strike
to + a hoe or other digging implement

verses.en: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken.
verses.zh: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄树下和无花果树下，无人惊吓。这是万军之耶和华亲口说的。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative
a mass of persons , especially reg. organized forwar

verses.en: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
verses.zh: 万民各奉己神的名而行；我们却永永远远奉耶和华―我们神的名而行。

verses.en: “In that day,” says the LORD, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;
verses.zh: 耶和华说：到那日，我必聚集瘸腿的，招聚被赶出的和我所惩治的。

verses.en: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”
verses.zh: 我必使瘸腿的为余剩之民，使赶到远方的为强盛之民。耶和华要在锡安山作王治理他们，从今直到永远。

words.g: to + a remainder or residual  portion
and + the + to remove or be remote

verses.en: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 你这羊群的高台、锡安城（原文是女子）的山哪，从前的权柄―就是耶路撒冷民（原文是女子）的国权―必归与你。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?
verses.zh: 现在你为何大声哭号呢？疼痛抓住你彷佛产难的妇人，是因你中间没有君王吗？你的谋士灭亡了吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
verses.zh: 锡安的民（原文是女子）哪，你要疼痛劬劳，彷佛产难的妇人；因为你必从城里出来，住在田野，到巴比伦去。在那里要蒙解救；在那里耶和华必救赎你脱离仇敌的手。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
and + to gush forth , generally to issue
and + to reside or permanently stay
Babel , including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
to be the next of kin + +you/your

verses.en: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”
verses.zh: 现在有许多国的民聚集攻击你，说：愿锡安被玷污！愿我们亲眼见她遭报！

words.g: to soil, especially in a moral sense
in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.zh: 他们却不知道耶和华的意念，也不明白他的筹划。他聚集他们，好像把禾捆聚到禾场一样。

verses.en: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to the LORD, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.zh: 锡安的民（原文是女子）哪，起来踹谷吧！我必使你的角成为铁，使你的蹄成为铜。你必打碎多国的民，将他们的财献与耶和华，将他们的货献与普天下的主。

words.g: and + a claw or split hoof + +you/your
and + probably a force, whether of men + +them/their

verses.en: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
verses.zh: 成群的民（原文是女子）哪，现在你要聚集成队；因为仇敌围攻我们，要用杖击打以色列审判者的脸。

words.g: something hemming in, i.e.  a mound

verses.en: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
verses.zh: 伯利恒的以法他啊，你在犹大诸城中为小，将来必有一位从你那里出来，在以色列中为我作掌权的；他的根源从亘古，从太初就有。

words.g: and + thou and thee, or  ye and you
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.
verses.zh: 耶和华必将以色列人交付敌人，直等那生产的妇人生下子来。那时掌权者（原文是他）其余的弟兄必归到以色列人那里。

words.g: and + an overhanging, i.e.  an excess

verses.en: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.
verses.zh: 他必起来，倚靠耶和华的大能，并耶和华―他神之名的威严，牧养他的羊群。他们要安然居住；因为他必日见尊大，直到地极。

verses.en: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.
verses.zh: 这位必作我们的平安。当亚述人进入我们的地境，践踏宫殿的时候，我们就立起七个牧者，八个首领攻击他。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
something poured out, i.e. a libation

verses.en: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.
verses.zh: 他们必用刀剑毁坏亚述地和宁录地的关口。亚述人进入我们的地境践踏的时候，他必拯救我们。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
in + an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way + +her/its
from + Ashshur, the second son of Shem
in + a cord , i.e.  a boundary + +us/our

verses.en: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.
verses.zh: 雅各余剩的人必在多国的民中，如从耶和华那里降下的露水，又如甘霖降在草上；不仗赖人力，也不等候世人之功。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center

verses.en: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.
verses.zh: 雅各余剩的人必在多国多民中，如林间百兽中的狮子，又如少壮狮子在羊群中。他若经过就必践踏撕裂，无人搭救。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
verses.zh: 愿你的手举起，高过敌人！愿你的仇敌都被剪除！

words.g: to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: “It will happen in that day”, says the LORD, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.
verses.zh: 耶和华说：到那日，我必从你中间剪除马匹，毁坏车辆，

words.g: from + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.
verses.zh: 也必从你国中除灭城邑，拆毁一切的保障，

words.g: and + to pull down or in pieces, break

verses.en: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
verses.zh: 又必除掉你手中的邪术；你那里也不再有占卜的。

words.g: and + to act covertly, i.e. practise magic

verses.en: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
verses.zh: 我必从你中间除灭雕刻的偶像和柱像，你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。

words.g: and + something stationed, i.e. a column or + +you/your
from + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
verses.zh: 我必从你中间拔出木偶，又毁灭你的城邑。

words.g: from + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”
verses.zh: 我也必在怒气和忿怒中向那不听从的列国施报。

verses.en: Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
verses.zh: 以色列人哪，当听耶和华的话！要起来向山岭争辩，使冈陵听你的话。

verses.en: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
verses.zh: 山岭和地永久的根基啊，要听耶和华争辩的话！因为耶和华要与他的百姓争辩，与以色列争论。

verses.en: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
verses.zh: 我的百姓啊，我向你做了甚么呢？我在甚么事上使你厌烦？你可以对我证明。

verses.en: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.zh: 我曾将你从埃及地领出来，从作奴仆之家救赎你；我也差遣摩西、亚伦，和米利暗在你前面行。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
and + Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses

verses.en: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”
verses.zh: 我的百姓啊，你们当追念摩押王巴勒所设的谋和比珥的儿子巴兰回答他的话，并你们从什亭到吉甲所遇见的事，好使你们知道耶和华公义的作为。

words.g: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot
Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king
the + Shittim, a place East of the Jordan
the + Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine

verses.en: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
verses.zh: 我朝见耶和华，在至高神面前跪拜，当献上甚么呢？岂可献一岁的牛犊为燔祭吗？

words.g: in + a  calf , especially one nearly grown

verses.en: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.zh: 耶和华岂喜悦千千的公羊，或是万万的油河吗？我岂可为自己的罪过献我的长子吗？为心中的罪恶献我身所生的吗？

words.g: a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verses.zh: 世人哪，耶和华已指示你何为善。他向你所要的是甚么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
verses.zh: 耶和华向这城呼叫，智慧人必敬畏他的名。你们当听是谁派定刑杖的惩罚。

words.g: and + support or  ability, i.e.  help

verses.en: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
verses.zh: 恶人家中不仍有非义之财和可恶的小升斗吗？

words.g: and + an ephah or measure for grain
to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged

verses.en: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?
verses.zh: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中诡诈的法码，岂可算为清洁呢？

verses.en: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
verses.zh: 城里的富户满行强暴；其中的居民也说谎言，口中的舌头是诡诈的。

words.g: in + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
verses.zh: 因此，我击打你，使你的伤痕甚重，使你因你的罪恶荒凉。

words.g: to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy

verses.en: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
verses.zh: 你要吃，却吃不饱；你的虚弱必显在你中间。你必挪去，却不得救护；所救护的，我必交给刀剑。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
in + the nearest part, i.e. the center + +you/your

verses.en: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
verses.zh: 你必撒种，却不得收割；踹橄榄，却不得油抹身；踹葡萄，却不得酒喝。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”
verses.zh: 因为你守暗利的恶规，行亚哈家一切所行的，顺从他们的计谋；因此，我必使你荒凉，使你的居民令人嗤笑，你们也必担当我民的羞辱。

words.g: Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon

verses.en: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.
verses.zh: 哀哉！我（或译：以色列）好像夏天的果子已被收尽，又像摘了葡萄所剩下的，没有一挂可吃的；我心羡慕初熟的无花果。

words.g: harvest , whether the product  or the  season
a bunch of grapes or other fruit

verses.en: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.
verses.zh: 地上虔诚人灭尽；世间没有正直人；各人埋伏，要杀人流血，都用网罗猎取弟兄。

verses.en: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.
verses.zh: 他们双手作恶；君王徇情面，审判官要贿赂；位分大的吐出恶意，都彼此结联行恶。

words.g: and + to interlace, i.e.  to pervert + +her/its

verses.en: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.
verses.zh: 他们最好的，不过是蒺藜；最正直的，不过是荆棘篱笆。你守望者说，降罚的日子已经来到。他们必扰乱不安。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance + +you/your

verses.en: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!
verses.zh: 不要倚赖邻舍；不要信靠密友。要守住你的口；不要向你怀中的妻提说。

words.g: an opening , i.e. door  or entrance way
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your

verses.en: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.zh: 因为，儿子藐视父亲；女儿抗拒母亲；媳妇抗拒婆婆；人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
verses.zh: 至于我，我要仰望耶和华，要等候那救我的神；我的神必应允我。

words.g: to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance

verses.en: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
verses.zh: 我的仇敌啊，不要向我夸耀。我虽跌倒，却要起来；我虽坐在黑暗里，耶和华却作我的光。

verses.en: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.
verses.zh: 我要忍受耶和华的恼怒；因我得罪了他，直等他为我辨屈，为我伸冤。他必领我到光明中；我必得见他的公义。

verses.en: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
verses.zh: 那时我的仇敌，就是曾对我说「耶和华―你神在哪里」的，他一看见这事就被羞愧遮盖。我必亲眼见他遭报；他必被践踏，如同街上的泥土。

verses.en: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
verses.zh: 以色列啊，日子必到，你的墙垣必重修；到那日，你的境界必开展（或译：命令必传到远方）。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
verses.zh: 当那日，人必从亚述，从埃及的城邑，从埃及到大河，从这海到那海，从这山到那山，都归到你这里。

words.g: Ashshur, the second son of Shem
something hemming in, i.e.  a mound

verses.en: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.zh: 然而，这地因居民的缘故，又因他们行事的结果，必然荒凉。

verses.en: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.zh: 求耶和华在迦密山的树林中，用你的杖牧放你独居的民，就是你产业的羊群。求你容他们在巴珊和基列得食物，像古时一样。

words.g: Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine
Bashan , a region East of the Jordan
and + Gilad, a region East of the Jordan

verses.en: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
verses.zh: 耶和华说：我要把奇事显给他们看，好像出埃及地的时候一样。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

verses.en: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
verses.zh: 列国看见这事就必为自己的势力惭愧；他们必用手捂口，掩耳不听。

words.g: and + to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
the mouth , whether literal or figurative

verses.en: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to the LORD our God, and will be afraid because of you.
verses.zh: 他们必舔土如蛇，又如土中腹行的物，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。他们必战惧投降耶和华，也必因我们的神而惧怕。

words.g: from + something enclosing, i.e. a margin + +them/their

verses.en: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
verses.zh: 神啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽，饶恕你产业之余民的罪过，不永远怀怒，喜爱施恩？

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +you/your
to + a remainder or residual  portion

verses.en: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.zh: 必再怜悯我们，将我们的罪孽踏在脚下，又将我们的一切罪投于深海。

verses.en: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
verses.zh: 你必按古时起誓应许我们列祖的话，向雅各发诚实，向亚伯拉罕施慈爱。

words.g: to + Abraham, the later name of Abram
to + father, in a literal and immediate + +us/our
